text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate from 0.2% -> 18% (last 2m). Severity: P1. Paging ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: on it — checking dashboards and logs. Paging infra eng.
sara: I saw errors pop up right after the 11:07 deploy canary. Rolling back canary now.
release-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T11:07Z started for service=runtime, version=gen-v2, targets=canary-2.
kevin: logs from canary instance: 
```
2026-03-15T11:09:13Z ERROR handler.go:142 failed to decrypt model key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/runtime-canary is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh
```
kevin: looks like KMS decrypt failing — likely key rotation or permissions change.
maria: Confirming. Trying `aws sts get-caller-identity` from canary, role looks correct. Throwing DecryptDenied.
ops-oncall: Can you confirm whether key was rotated in the deploy? @kevin @sara
sara: I pushed a change that picks up a new KMS key id from env VAR KMS_KEY_ID during the rollout. Canary envs got the new value, prod still on old one — but IAM role for canary doesn't have decrypt for the new key. Bad assumption in the deploy.
kevin: Ah — the rollout included rotated key config without ensuring role binding. Canary hit failures because role wasn't granted decrypt on the new key.
ops-oncall: Impact assessment — we see failures on canary only so far, but traffic was routed to canary. Any customer-facing errors?
kevin: Yes, ~2100 requests failed in 2m window; some requests retried by clients, but two customers (acme-inc, beta-startup) reported increased errors.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01. Slack channel thread linked.
sara: Immediate mitigation: rollback gen-v2 canary to previous config and flip feature flag that routes traffic to gen-v2. I'll flip the flag first.
alice: I can handle flag toggle via LaunchDarkly — which flag?
sara: flag: feature.gen_v2_route -> set to false (kill-switch).
alice: toggling now...
alice: :white_check_mark: feature.gen_v2_route -> false. Routing back to gen-v1.
ops-oncall: Good. Maria — start rollback of the canary deploy and revert env var change in the canary group.
maria: Rolling back now. `release-bot rollback 2026-03-15T11:07Z --targets canary-2`
release-bot: Rollback initiated for deploy 2026-03-15T11:07Z. Progress: 0/2 canaries -> 2/2 completed.
release-bot: Rollback complete for service=runtime, version=gen-v2. Traffic routing reverted.
kevin: After kill-switch + rollback, error rate dropped back to baseline. Metrics: 5xx -> 0.3% within 90s.
ops-oncall: Customer impact summary: intermittent failed requests for ~6 minutes, total ~2.3k failed requests, two enterprise customers saw errors (support tickets opened). No data exfiltration or degraded latency beyond errors.
irene: Post-incident tasks: 1) Add pre-deploy check to validate KMS key bindings for any new KMS_KEY_ID in config; 2) Ensure IAM role binding automation runs before canary gets new env; 3) Add alert for sudden spike in kms:Decrypt AccessDenied errors.
sara: Agreed. Also we should forbid swapping KMS_KEY_ID in the same deploy where role bindings are changed — require separate rollout.
kevin: I'll open a PR to make deploy pipeline validate KMS permissions explicitly.
alice: Created INC-2026-0315-01 ticket in ops, linked support tickets for acme-inc and beta-startup, and scheduled a follow-up postmortem tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
ops-oncall: On-call handoff note: I'm staying until postmortem summary posted. If anyone else needs to take over, ping me.
incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity lowered to P2, timeline appended.
ops-oncall: Closing thread for now; will add final timeline + remediation plan in the incident ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
